positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Prototype hardware solutions using ESP32 microcontrollers for LoRa, Bluetooth, and WiFi
Link multiple software and hardware nodes and perform end-to-end testing and development
Design and lead development for full-stack web application portion of product
Built REST API and admin dashboard for quick relational database access
Own modernization of hardware GUI moving from Qt to React Native
Analyze user needs and business requirements to determine software design
Ensure accurate and consistent data flow from hardware to software microservices
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · Software Engineering Practices · Programming Languages · Software Development · Test-Driven Development · Microservices · Full-Stack Development · Webpack

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Volunteer developer work for a fashion startup
Aided in designing the architecture and microservice orchestration of new web app
Maintained and refactored code to ensure library and package upgrades succeeded
Leveraged AI to achieve 80% unit test coverage of utility and helper functions
Reshaped data structures to allow for new features in the front end
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Web Applications · Redis · Software Engineering Practices · Programming Languages · TypeScript · Back-End Web Development · Software Development · Test-Driven Development · Microservices · Full-Stack Development · Webpack · Next.js

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Implemented and designed new UI components that improved end user’s ability to manage assets and cut response times to customer concerns by 50-75%
Led modernization of team’s front-end testing procedures that identified technical bugs before they hit production 
Improved endpoint performance by 10-15% using Django ORM queries 
Developed algorithm to convert proprietary data into standard GeoJSON
Served as release manager for team’s contribution to production environment

positions.title: Human Resources Generalist
positions.description:
Managed HRIS, streamlined interdepartmental reporting and mediated conflict resolution
Provided complete employee onboarding experience, standardized operating procedures and administered benefits

positions.title: Customer Service Associate
positions.description:
Provided weekly reports to product from customer data analysis
Resolved average of 60 support tickets daily
Identified patterns indicating outages and escalated to engineering

positions.title: Human Resources Specialist
positions.description: Processed hourly payroll, produced training material and created wage reporting system

positions.title: City Launcher
positions.description:
Coordinated with local governments, acquired warehousing and established operations
Expanded operations to six cities while hiring seven managers and 120 associates

positions.title: Operations Supervisor
positions.description: Directed day to day activities within the workplace under manager

positions.title: Lab and Field Technician
positions.description: Sampled and tested as part of geotechnical engineering team

positions.title: Fish Captain
positions.description:
Provided customers with a positive experience in a point-of-sale environment.
Received and placed animals in their correct habitats.
Informed customers of the particulars of fish care and temperament.
Maintained aquarium systems using knowledge of related chemicals and
hardware.
